welcome:
👋 Welcome to Media Downloader Bot!

Send me a public link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Pinterest and I will send the media back to you.

Use /help for details. Choose your language below:
welcome_group:
👋 Media Downloader Bot is active in this group.

Send a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Pinterest link and I will reply with the media.

Choose your language below (only affects your own messages):
help:
ℹ️ How to use this bot

Send a public link from one of these platforms:
{platforms}

I reply to your message with the downloaded file. Links to private, removed or unsupported content cannot be downloaded.

Limits: files up to {max_size} MB, media up to {max_duration}, up to {max_links} links per message.

Commands:
/start - welcome message
/help - this help
/language - change your language
notice_extra_links: Only the first {count} links in this message are processed.
rate_limited: You are sending links too quickly. Please wait a minute and try again.
maintenance: The service is under maintenance. Please try again later.
queue_full: The download queue is full right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
service_unavailable: The download service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
unsupported_link: This link is unsupported or inaccessible.
inaccessible: This link is unsupported or inaccessible.
too_large: The file exceeds the configured size limit ({limit} MB).
too_long: The media is longer than the configured duration limit.
unsupported_media: This type of media is not available from this platform.
multiple_items: This post contains several media items, which are not supported yet.
timeout: The download took too long and was stopped. Please try again later.
download_failed: The download failed. Please try again.
upload_failed: The file was downloaded but could not be sent to Telegram. Please try again.
not_configured: This platform is not available right now.
